pubcol-w-df0ae45ab0dea768.definition_en: to actually use an idea, method, or plan in a real situation
pubcol-w-df0ae45ab0dea768.example_simple: It is time to put what we learned into practice.
pubcol-w-df0ae45ab0dea768.example_complex: The training was useful, but only when she put the techniques into practice did she truly master them.

pubcol-w-cf5296e94af3f0c1.definition_en: to make a place, person, or thing become well known or important
collocations: put the town on the map
put the company on the map
put the region on the map
pubcol-w-cf5296e94af3f0c1.example_simple: The new festival really put the small town on the map.
pubcol-w-cf5296e94af3f0c1.example_complex: A single viral video was enough to put the once-obscure startup firmly on the map.

pubcol-w-3540aa3b54c90803.definition_en: to say that someone or something is responsible for something bad
collocations: put the blame on the weather
pubcol-w-3540aa3b54c90803.example_simple: Don't put the blame on me for the mistake.
pubcol-w-3540aa3b54c90803.example_complex: Rather than examine their own strategy, the managers put the blame on external market conditions.

pubcol-w-68e86c00f9add25c.definition_en: to make the final small improvements that complete something
collocations: put the finishing touches on a report
put the finishing touches on the meal
put the finishing touches on a design
pubcol-w-68e86c00f9add25c.example_simple: She put the finishing touches on the cake before the party.
pubcol-w-68e86c00f9add25c.example_complex: After months of work, the architect spent a week putting the finishing touches on the museum's interior.

pubcol-w-3c62f03fc6b6d79d.definition_en: to go as fast as possible, or to make a big effort to do something quickly
collocations: really put the pedal to the metal
time to put the pedal to the metal
put the pedal to the metal on the project
pubcol-w-3c62f03fc6b6d79d.example_simple: We're late, so put the pedal to the metal.
pubcol-w-3c62f03fc6b6d79d.example_complex: With the deadline looming, the whole team had to put the pedal to the metal to finish on time.

pubcol-w-eaa40b3a75b31e26.definition_en: to say or do something that causes trouble, worry, or argument among people
collocations: really put the cat among the pigeons
set the cat among the pigeons
put the cat among the pigeons with a question
pubcol-w-eaa40b3a75b31e26.example_simple: His question put the cat among the pigeons at the meeting.
pubcol-w-eaa40b3a75b31e26.example_complex: By revealing the leaked figures, the journalist set the cat among the pigeons within the ruling party.

pubcol-w-ee66aa4cc9c19938.definition_en: to make people pay an official charge on a particular good or activity
collocations: put a tax on sugary drinks
pubcol-w-ee66aa4cc9c19938.example_simple: The government decided to put a tax on plastic bags.
pubcol-w-ee66aa4cc9c19938.example_complex: Several countries have put a tax on carbon emissions in an effort to curb pollution.

pubcol-w-33ac88956681b7c7.example_simple: The rubbish had a putrid smell.
pubcol-w-33ac88956681b7c7.example_complex: A putrid stench rose from the neglected pond, forcing everyone to keep their distance.

pubcol-w-bc71d0c3f7f9efb1.definition_en: to let someone stay in your home for a night or a short time
collocations: put a friend up for the night
put someone up for a few days
pubcol-w-bc71d0c3f7f9efb1.example_simple: We can put you up for the weekend if you like.
pubcol-w-bc71d0c3f7f9efb1.example_complex: When the storm cancelled all the flights, the family kindly put several stranded travellers up for the night.

pubcol-w-5176ced934976c4c.definition_en: to say that someone is responsible for something bad that happened
collocations: put the blame on someone else
put the blame on the staff
pubcol-w-5176ced934976c4c.example_simple: They put the blame on the new employee.
pubcol-w-5176ced934976c4c.example_complex: It was cowardly of him to put the blame on his assistant for a decision he had made himself.

pubcol-w-6fd82bdc7a3617c3.definition_en: to make someone feel ashamed, or to be so much better that others seem inferior
pubcol-w-6fd82bdc7a3617c3.example_simple: Her hard work put the rest of us to shame.
pubcol-w-6fd82bdc7a3617c3.example_complex: The young pianist's flawless performance put the seasoned professionals to shame.

pubcol-w-836db3d3d8721d91.definition_en: to accept or tolerate someone or something unpleasant without complaining
pubcol-w-836db3d3d8721d91.example_simple: I can't put up with this noise any longer.
pubcol-w-836db3d3d8721d91.example_complex: For years she put up with a long, exhausting commute simply to keep the job she loved.

84ff26a0-1a1c-48a5-8697-d8da75327acb.definition_en: a flat shape with four straight sides

pubcol-w-2464d3be9d9f48cd.definition_en: small shops that are attractive in an old-fashioned or charming way
pubcol-w-2464d3be9d9f48cd.example_simple: The village is full of quaint shops selling handmade goods.
pubcol-w-2464d3be9d9f48cd.example_complex: Wandering through the old town, we discovered narrow lanes lined with quaint shops that seemed untouched by time.

pubcol-w-006442b3906c8431.definition_en: an official record showing you have passed an exam or completed training
pubcol-w-006442b3906c8431.example_simple: She has a qualification in nursing.
pubcol-w-006442b3906c8431.example_complex: Employers increasingly value practical experience alongside formal academic qualifications.

pubcol-w-9f04d6a7d7bb8138.definition_en: having the training, skills, or knowledge needed to do something
pubcol-w-9f04d6a7d7bb8138.example_complex: Only candidates who are fully qualified and experienced will be considered for the senior position.

pubcol-w-4e8dbcca4241621b.definition_en: the personal characteristics and skills that are required to do a particular thing
collocations: the qualities and abilities needed for the role
possess the qualities and abilities needed
demonstrate the qualities and abilities needed
pubcol-w-4e8dbcca4241621b.example_simple: She has all the qualities and abilities needed for the job.
pubcol-w-4e8dbcca4241621b.example_complex: The interview is designed to reveal whether applicants truly have the qualities and abilities needed for such a demanding leadership role.

pubcol-w-4ff18f00176f0f2b.definition_en: how good or bad something is; a high standard
pubcol-w-4ff18f00176f0f2b.example_simple: This shop sells clothes of very good quality.
pubcol-w-4ff18f00176f0f2b.example_complex: Consumers are often willing to pay more for products whose quality is consistently reliable.

a47a34a4-4669-4b84-94e7-cf65f3cd3998.definition_en: a state of not knowing what to do in a difficult situation

pubcol-w-6a4060f4d918aeda.definition_en: an amount or number of something
pubcol-w-6a4060f4d918aeda.example_simple: We need a large quantity of water for the trip.
pubcol-w-6a4060f4d918aeda.example_complex: The factory can produce goods in enormous quantities without sacrificing precision.

pubcol-w-20f7bbd2bf1120bf.example_simple: He becomes quarrelsome when he is tired.
pubcol-w-20f7bbd2bf1120bf.example_complex: The meeting dissolved into chaos as the usually calm committee turned unexpectedly quarrelsome.

pubcol-w-7cd9148ec5a552db.example_simple: If you have a query, please email us.
pubcol-w-7cd9148ec5a552db.example_complex: The support team responds to every customer query within twenty-four hours.

pubcol-w-e5478a94af5422fe.definition_en: not suitable for a particular situation, or not in the correct position
pubcol-w-e5478a94af5422fe.example_simple: In my old clothes, I felt out of place at the party.
pubcol-w-e5478a94af5422fe.example_complex: The sleek glass tower looked oddly out of place among the neighbourhood's historic stone buildings.

pubcol-w-8a23fc6a1d2eb1c1.definition_en: a small amount of food eaten quickly between meals
pubcol-w-8a23fc6a1d2eb1c1.example_simple: I grabbed a quick snack before the meeting.
pubcol-w-8a23fc6a1d2eb1c1.example_complex: Between back-to-back lectures, students often rely on a quick snack to keep their energy up.
